upstream.install: pip install chai_lab==0.6.1   # == pip install stock/chai_lab-0.6.1-py3-none-any.whl (same bytes)

wheel.note: the wheel's chai_lab/ directory is byte-identical to the tag's (102 files, none differ, none missing either way); stock/src is the git archive of the tag (chai_lab/ + LICENSE, README.md, pyproject.toml, requirements.in, Dockerfile.chailab)

cli.note: typer over run_inference (chai_lab/main.py:38); every route of this tree calls run_inference directly

dockerfile.note: installs requirements.in through uv; declares no torch/CUDA version, no lock file at the tag

stack.note: the torch / CUDA stack this tree was tested on — every mode (off, exact, fast, big), stock and kit alike, on one and the same stack
stack.tested_on: the pinned stack below (torch 2.13.0+cu130, CUDA 13.0, cuDNN 9.20.0, triton 3.7.1, Python 3.11.5) on NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90) — documentation only: nothing reads or compares this line
stack.torch_vs_declared_range: outside the stock wheel's declared torch<2.7,>=2.3.1 (upstream); chai_lab 0.6.1 is installed on it with that requirement relaxed and runs unmodified from source — stock's outputs on it are what the kit modes are compared with (stock/check_pins.py records any other torch / CUDA build as STACK not pinned and, under --strict-stack, refuses it)

stacks.note: the pinned stacks, by stack key (torch<version sans local tag>-cu<CUDA>-sm<compute capability>, chai1_opt.stack.stack_key): `stack` above is the only one — every mode (off, exact, fast, big; stock and kit alike on one torch / CUDA stack). On any other torch / CUDA build every mode runs with the record `STACK not pinned: torch <v>+<cuda> (pinned: torch 2.13.0+cu130)` (stock/check_pins.py stack_verdict; the package's NOTE line and opt_manifest.json stack_pinned / stack_line); --strict-stack / CHAI1_OPT_STRICT_STACK=1 refuses it instead. exact is bit-for-bit equal to stock under --det 1 on one and the same stack; fast and big match stock inside stock's seed-to-seed band

torch2.13.0-cu130-sm90.gpu: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90); B200 (sm100) in the eager stack's record
torch2.13.0-cu130-sm90.role: the tree's pinned stack (`stack`): every mode; exact's bit-for-bit runs and fast / big's band runs were measured on it against stock on it
torch2.13.0-cu130-sm90.torch_vs_declared_range: outside the stock wheel's declared torch<2.7 (stock/PINS.json upstream); the pinned stack carries chai_lab 0.6.1 on this torch regardless (installed without letting pip re-resolve torch) and stock runs unmodified from source

model_sizes.source: chai_lab/data/collate/utils.py:13 — the crop size is the smallest bin >= the token count; largest 2048 (raise_if_too_many_tokens, chai1.py:242)

weights.sha256_note: sha256 of the eight files as they are read by this tree (also the kit driver's own PROVENANCE lines at start-up); upstream publishes no digests for them
weights.fetch_policy: nothing is fetched at run time: the package refuses when a file is missing (stack.weights_check); upstream and the kit would download from the CDN

stock_environment.note: the package's own switch (CHAI1_OPT), the kit's recipe and mirror variables, and the recipe's cuBLAS variable: a stock process carries none of them and no kit directory on sys.path (opt/chai1_opt/stock_fold.py env_proof); every other CHAI_* name is refused too (only CHAI_DOWNLOADS_DIR is upstream's)
